t: This is Battersea Reference Library, a reference library in a Grade II listed building on Altenburg Gardens in Battersea. It was designed by Henry Benjamin Hyams, a British architect and structural engineer who was active in the early twentieth century. Hyams is known for two restaurants in Devon and two buildings in Battersea, and this is one of them. He was also an Esperanto instructor, and during the First World War he was a conscientious objector. Take a look at the building and think of the person behind it.
